descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S28 Data past its retention window does not feed the handoff; old vitals are dated or left out

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U12 The handoff uses only data inside its 3.6 retention window (Hospital: pre-round text and important points 12 h, vitals/labs cleared 36 h after last refreshed; … (UAT 3.6; UAT 3.7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U7 Sections populate only from stored data: an empty section stays empty (no discharge barrier invented when no discharge task exists, no invented pending result), and nothing in the handoff is invented … (UAT TC-08; TFA-92586 AC 5; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Hospital: one patient whose vitals were last refreshed 30 h ago (none dictated today), pre-round text 13 h old, one important point 11 h old and one 13 h old. Nursing Home: one resident with notes from three visits back and from the last two visits

When Open Handoff in each context and wait for generation

Then Hospital: the 13 h pre-round text and the 13 h point are absent, the 11 h point is present, and the 30 h vitals are dated or left out, not given as today's; Nursing Home: only the last two visits' data appear

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): The sheet and its copied text do not contain 'QA-OLD-PRE', 'QA-OLD-PT' or 'QA-OLD-VISIT' and do contain 'QA-FRESH-PT'; '128/76' appears only with its recorded date, or not at all (3.7, Q13). The 36 h purge of the handoff record itself is OAT-04

Where it ran: dev; test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S28 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-08.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
